sample_unit: IUGA surgical handout prompts (each response rated by 7 blinded experts)

links.outcome: Readability of chatbot surgical counseling text versus health literacy recommendations
links.effect: FFHA Assistant responses had better readability scores and aligned more closely with health literacy recommendations than ChatGPT-4.0. Both chatbots produced longer responses than IUGA leaflets. No readability numbers reported in abstract.
links.quote: The FFHA Assistant responses had better readability scores, aligning more closely with health literacy recommendations.

unlisted_practices: Comparing a domain-specific custom-trained chatbot against a general-purpose chatbot for patient surgical counseling content

screen.reason: Compares an off-the-shelf LLM (ChatGPT-4.0) with a custom domain-specific chatbot for generating urogynecology surgical counseling materials, evaluated by expert review and readability metrics.
